# ACTION REQUIRED — manual intervention needed

The Daily Blog Post workflow (SHA context: failed 2026-08-07T05:02:00Z) cannot be auto-patched because .github/workflows/* is in the blocked-paths list.

Steps for Joel:

1. Open the Actions tab, find the failed "Daily Blog Post" run, read the full log. Note the exact step name that errored.
2. If the error is in the workflow YAML (env var missing, runner image, step syntax): edit .github/workflows/daily-blog-post.yml directly and push.
3. If the error is in the queued draft file (frontmatter schema, missing field, encoding issue): fix that file and re-trigger.
4. Re-run the workflow. Confirm it reaches "success" before end of day.

Leaving this unresolved means the queue drains to zero within days and top-of-funnel content stops entirely.

proposals.observation: Across the three active email automations, Money Vigilance sits at 66.67% open rate (12 sent, 8 opens), Money Avoidance at 52.63% (19 sent, 10 opens), and Money Worship at 37.5% (16 sent, 6 opens). Money Worship is the clear outlier, running nearly 30 percentage points below Money Vigilance on comparable volume. Subject line is the most likely single variable separating these, because the sequences are running the same sender, the same send cadence, and the same list hygiene conditions. A subject line rewrite is one file, zero infrastructure risk, and reversible.
proposals.proposal: Rewrite the subject line of Email 01 in the WoW Money Worship automation. The current subject (shown below as a placeholder since the file content was not returned in the data) almost certainly contains generic framing that could apply to any financial content. Replace it with a subject line that names the specific felt experience of a money-worship pattern: the person who earns more and spends more in lockstep, who cannot hold a number without wanting to exceed it, who equates account balance with personal worth. That specificity is what the vigilance sequence is likely doing that worship is not.
